title: Roster Agent
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a roster member identity file. Validates roster/<name>.md frontmatter; the markdown body holds agent-specific persona text and is appended to the system prompt at runtime.

$schema.description: JSON Schema self-reference pointer. Optional in frontmatter.

name.description: Kebab-case unique identifier. Must match the filename stem of roster/<name>.md.

stance.description: Reference to a stance defined in stances/<stance>.md. Single primary stance per agent.

secondary_stances.description: Optional secondary stances. Use sparingly; the value of stance specialization erodes when an agent claims too many.

backing.description: Backing model declaration. What runs the agent at inference time.

type.description: hosted = a remote model API. cli = inside a command-line agent session that acts as the orchestrator. local = a local runtime such as Ollama, llama.cpp, or vLLM.

model.description: Model identifier. Examples: '<provider>/<model>' for a hosted model, 'local/<model>' for a local runtime.

reasoning_effort.description: For models that expose effort tuning. Otherwise ignored.

context_size.description: Effective context window in tokens. Local models often have smaller windows than the model card claims under quantization.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Stance-typed agents typically run lower temperature for consistency.

compute.description: Where this agent runs. Declared so plays can match agents to available hardware.

device.description: Named device or 'any' (portable across the principal's hardware) or 'api' (no local compute, remote API only).

tier.description: Compute class. api = remote API. gpu = local GPU acceleration required. cpu = will run on CPU (slow for large local models).

vram_gb.description: Minimum VRAM required for local GPU agents. Set the floor for the smallest local GPU in the deployment.

memory.description: Persistent memory configuration. Optional. Without this block, the agent runs ephemeral.

path.description: Relative path to memory file. Convention: roster/<name>.memory.md.

retention_policy.description: What gets written to memory. 'all' is rare and usually wrong; 'scrimmage-summaries-only' is the default sane choice; 'manual' means the agent decides per write.

status.description: active = available for scrimmages. inactive = on the bench. draft = identity not yet finalized, do not assign to scrimmages.

created.description: Date the agent identity was first declared (YYYY-MM-DD).

last_active.description: Date of most recent scrimmage participation. Updated by the orchestrator.

tags.description: Free-form tags for grouping and filtering.

notes.description: Optional free-form note about this agent.
